title: tad-clip subtitle edits (edits.json)
description: Written by Claude after reading review.md. Every cue number i refers to the numbering in review.md (the raw cues), never to a renumbered list. A cue can have one correction and can be part of one resplit (the resplit is applied after the corrections, so its lines must use the corrected words); a dropped cue cannot be touched by anything else. If more than half of the cues are touched, finalize refuses (exit 3).

corrections.description: Fix the wording of one cue. Timing is kept. from must equal the cue text exactly. The same cue may also be part of a resplit.

from.description: Whole current line, character for character

resplit.description: Move the line break between adjacent cues (or split one cue). Applied after the corrections: the lines in `to` must hold the same words as the (corrected) cues, only spaces and break positions may change.

drop.description: Remove a cue entirely, for example when the same words already sit on screen as burned-in text.

from.description: Whole current line, character for character

flags.description: Doubts that are not fixed. They go into edits-report.md for a human to decide.

notes.description: One or two lines summarising the review
